name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
benefit: - **One-Time Financial Assistance:** Financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- is provided for establishing a Village Level Soil Testing Lab (VLSTL).  - **Assistance for Soil Testing Equipment:** Up to ₹1,00,000/- for soil testing equipment, reagents, sample shaker machine, and one-year Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC).  - **Assistance for Laboratory Consumables:** Up to ₹50,000/- for distilled water,
_eligibility_text: - The Age of the applicant should be between 18 to 27 years - The Educational Qualification of the applicant should be 10th pass with science and knowledge of computer - The applicant / entrepreneur group should have their own premises / rented building with lease agreement for atleast four years.
